posterior: exp(-||f-b||^2/(2 sigma^2)) on f>=0 and A*f=c. A Gaussian prior-error assumption, not proved by observed count covariance. No learned global beta is applied to the center.
moves: Random state-independent triangle directions: long(i,k) +t, short(i,j)-t, short(j,k)-t.75% adjacent-split triples,25% uniform triples; exact truncated-normal line conditional. Counted operator must satisfy tested path concatenation identities.
convergence_gate: Raw split-Rhat<1.05 and approximate autocorrelation ESS>=100 for total, priorL1,logdensity and20 fixed path entries. These diagnostics do not establish model correctness.
ranking: No decision ranking unless gate passes. No hidden-reference score is evaluated; model posterior expectations, if later computed, are assumptions only.
scope: Single-panel sampling correctness/mixing pilot, not a new official candidate or full-system validation. Frozen baseline unchanged, no Kaggle uploads.
